visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a high-resolution close-up of a finished Peach Blossom Pastry, showcasing its intricate flower shape, golden-brown crust, and black sesame seed center. It rests on a dark wooden platter with a soft-focus background of more pastries. (2) Hands wearing transparent plastic gloves take a disc of dough and roll it into a tight cylinder on a light-colored wooden cutting board. A white chef's sleeve is visible at the edge of the frame under bright studio lighting. (3) The dough cylinder is sliced into three even pieces with a metal knife, and each piece is rolled into a smooth sphere by the gloved hands. Three portions of dark, reddish-brown bean paste are also rolled into balls. (4) A dough ball is flattened, and a bean paste ball is placed in the center. The hands wrap the dough around the filling, sealing it at the top and rolling it back into a sphere before flattening it into a thick disc. (5) Five radial cuts are made into the disc with a knife, stopping short of the center. Each petal is then pinched and slightly twisted to reveal the dark filling inside, forming a distinct blossom shape. (6) A yellow brush applies egg wash to the pastry, followed by a sprinkle of black sesame seeds in the middle. The pastries are then shown baking inside an oven until the crust turns a rich, golden color.

The narrator continues explaining the preparation steps clearly. The BGM remains at a consistent level, providing a bright harmonic backdrop. The narrator's speech is enunciated and well-paced, perfectly synchronized with the musical rhythm and visual cuts. (4) A metallic click and impact sound occur as a knife cuts through the dough. The narrator explains the filling process with a warm inflection. The guitar strumming provides a sense of energy and movement. (5) Another knife impact sound marks the petal-shaping phase. (6) The video concludes with the narrator's encouraging final remarks as the BGM resolves on a final major chord and fades out quickly. The overall audio quality is professional and studio-clean.
